moments.title: Bake Off Returns with a New Judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off Series 17 premieres on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: General Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and Hollywood handshakes! The Great British Bake Off is back on September 22nd. Who's your money on for Star Baker this year?

angles.name: New Judge Focus
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The culinary queen joins Paul Hollywood for Series 17 starting September 22nd. Can't wait to see her critiques!

angles.name: Hosts Return
angles.copy: Alison Hammond and Noel Fielding are back to bring the chaos and comfort to the Bake Off tent! Catch the new series from September 22nd on Channel 4.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns for its 24th series with the launch show on Saturday, September 19, 2026, at 7:25 pm on BBC One and iPlayer, introducing new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Launch Show Anticipation
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing's launch show is this Saturday, September 19th on BBC One. Who are you excited to see hit the ballroom?

angles.name: New Hosts Reveal
angles.copy: Big changes in the ballroom! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are your new Strictly hosts. See them in action from September 19th!

angles.name: Live Shows Start Next Week
angles.copy: The pairings are revealed this Saturday, and then the live shows begin on September 26th! Get ready for a dazzling series of Strictly Come Dancing.

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues with a full schedule of fixtures on Saturday, September 19, 2026, including major clashes across the UK.

angles.name: Matchday Hype
angles.copy: Premier League is back this Saturday, September 19th! Who's playing who and what are your score predictions for the weekend's action?

angles.name: Weekend Forecast
angles.copy: Get ready for a massive Saturday of football on September 19th! Which Premier League fixture are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Jason Derulo's 37th Birthday
moments.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and dancer Jason Derulo celebrates his 37th birthday on Monday, September 21, 2026.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 37th birthday to the one and only Jason Derulo this Monday! What's your favourite track from the hitmaker?

angles.name: Dance Anthem King
angles.copy: From 'Whatcha Say' to 'Savage Love', Jason Derulo always delivers the bangers. He turns 37 on Monday – get ready to dance!

moments.title: Astronomical Autumn Begins
moments.blurb: The Autumn Equinox, marking the start of astronomical autumn in the Northern Hemisphere, occurs on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 01:05 BST.

angles.name: Seasonal Change
angles.copy: It's official: astronomical autumn begins this Wednesday, September 23rd! Get ready for cosier nights and beautiful changing leaves. What's your favourite thing about autumn?

angles.name: Longer Nights
angles.copy: The nights are drawing in! The Autumn Equinox on September 23rd means days get shorter and nights get longer. Perfect for snuggling up!

moments.title: Last Chance for Heritage Open Days
moments.blurb: Heritage Open Days in England conclude on September 20, 2026, offering free access to thousands of historic sites and hidden gems.

angles.name: Final Weekend Reminder
angles.copy: Don't miss out! This is the final weekend for Heritage Open Days across England, ending September 20th. Explore hidden history for free before it's too late!

angles.name: Local History Angle
angles.copy: What local historic gems are you visiting this weekend? It's the last chance to explore thousands of sites for free during Heritage Open Days, finishing September 20th!

moments.title: Open Doors Wales Continues
moments.blurb: Open Doors Wales runs throughout September 2026, providing free access to over 200 historic sites, landmarks, and hidden gems across the country.

angles.name: Welsh Heritage Exploration
angles.copy: Discover the rich history of Wales for free! Open Doors Wales continues all month, offering access to over 200 amazing sites. Where will you explore next?

angles.name: Local Welsh Gems
angles.copy: From ancient castles to hidden chapels, Open Doors Wales is your chance to see your local history come alive. It runs throughout September – don't miss out!

moments.title: Abergavenny Food Festival
moments.blurb: The Abergavenny Food Festival takes place this weekend, September 19-20, 2026, in Monmouthshire, South Wales, featuring tastings, chef demos, and local produce.

angles.name: Foodie Weekend in Wales
angles.copy: Calling all food lovers! The Abergavenny Food Festival is this weekend, September 19-20. Get ready for delicious tastings, chef demos, and the best of Welsh produce!

angles.name: Party in the Castle
angles.copy: Beyond the food, Abergavenny Food Festival also brings 'Party in the Castle' this weekend! Two stages, four bands, and fireworks – don't miss it, Sept 19-20!

moments.title: York Food and Drink Festival
moments.blurb: The York Food and Drink Festival runs from September 18-27, 2026, celebrating local and regional food and drink with markets, demonstrations, and workshops.

angles.name: Yorkshire Foodie Fun
angles.copy: The York Food and Drink Festival kicks off this Friday, September 18th, running until the 27th! A celebration of the best local produce and culinary talent. Who's going?

angles.name: Taste of Yorkshire
angles.copy: From market stalls to cooking demos, the York Food and Drink Festival is a must-visit for any foodie. Starting September 18th, running for over a week!

moments.title: Equinox Festival in Lincolnshire
moments.blurb: Equinox Festival, a grassroots music and arts event, takes place from September 17-21, 2026, in Lincolnshire, marking the close of the UK festival season.

angles.name: Festival Season Closer
angles.copy: Last chance for a festival fix! Equinox Festival kicks off this Thursday, September 17th in Lincolnshire, bringing grassroots music and arts until the 21st.

angles.name: Lincolnshire Vibes
angles.copy: Ready for some grassroots music and good vibes? Equinox Festival is happening in Lincolnshire from September 17-21. Who's heading there?

moments.title: Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival Starts
moments.blurb: Tulleys Farm in West Sussex launches its Pumpkin Festival on September 19, 2026, running until October 31, offering millions of pumpkins, seasonal food, and entertainment.

angles.name: Autumn Fun Kicks Off
angles.copy: Pumpkin season officially begins! Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival starts this Saturday, September 19th, in West Sussex. Get ready for all things autumnal!

angles.name: Family Day Out
angles.copy: Looking for a fun family day out? Tulleys Farm Pumpkin Festival opens this Saturday, September 19th, with millions of pumpkins and entertainment until Halloween!
